dialogue.content: こんにちは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for meeting with me today. We'll begin at our scheduled time.

dialogue.content: こんにちは承知いたしました。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I understand. I look forward to speaking with you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。最初に年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 21才男です
dialogue.English: I'm a 21-year-old man.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はい、実家から離れて専門学校に通ってます。コロナ禍で、全てダメですこの先、希望が持てません。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm attending a vocational school away from my family home. Because of the pandemic, everything feels ruined, and I can't see any hope for the future.

dialogue.content: そのようなお気持ちなんですね。コロナで色々なことが起こっていて、長く続いていますし、しんどくなってしまいますよね、
dialogue.English: I see that's how you're feeling. So much has happened because of the pandemic, and it's been going on for so long. It's understandable to feel worn out.

dialogue.content: あんなに、希望に満ちて入学したのに…
dialogue.English: And to think, I was so full of hope when I started school...

dialogue.content: ええ、苦しいお気持ちなんですよね。この時間で少しでもお話をお聞きできればと思っています。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can hear how painful this is for you. I'm here to listen to whatever you'd like to share during our time today.

dialogue.content: ご実家を離れて、という事でしたが今はおひとりで暮らしていらっしゃるんですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you’re away from your family home—are you living on your own now?

dialogue.content: 今は専門学校の側の寮に入ってます。
dialogue.English: I'm currently in a dorm near the vocational school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、今は何年目になるんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What year are you in now?

dialogue.content: 2年弱です
dialogue.English: Just under two years.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだったんですね、専門学校は何の専門学校か、差し支えなければお聞きしても良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. If you don't mind me asking, what kind of vocational school is it?

dialogue.content: 微生物などの研究なんですが…もともと、この業界はレアで就職先も少なくて…勉学も進まず未来が…無いです
dialogue.English: I'm studying research on things like microorganisms... but this field is niche to begin with, and there are few job opportunities... My studies aren't progressing, and I feel like my future is nonexistent.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そういった研究もされるんですね。教えてくださってありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see, so you're doing that kind of research. Thank you for sharing.

dialogue.content: 先ほど、コロナで全てがだめだと仰っていましたがなにかそう感じられるきっかけがあったんですか？
dialogue.English: Earlier you said that because of COVID everything feels hopeless. Was there something in particular that led you to feel that way?

dialogue.content: 講義は、ここに来てまた、停止状態、バイトも飲食店で稼げない、奨学金…返金出来る気がしない…
dialogue.English: Lectures have been suspended again since I got here, I can't earn money at my restaurant job, and my student loans... I don't see how I'll ever be able to pay them back.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、そうだったんですね....希望をもって勉強に励もうとしていたのに色々なことが予定とは違う方向に進んでしまって不安な気持ちも出てきてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, I see... You were trying so hard to study with hope for the future, but so many things have gone in a different direction than you planned. It's natural that you'd feel anxious.

dialogue.content: 苦しい中よくがんばっていらっしゃいますよね
dialogue.English: You're doing so well to keep going through all this hardship.

dialogue.content: 自分では、頑張れている感じが全く無くて…尚更辛くなるんです
dialogue.English: I don't feel at all like I'm doing my best... which makes it even harder.

dialogue.content: そうかそうか...そのギャップも今はしんどくなる材料になってしまうのかもしれませんね...そのくらい苦しいお気持ちなんですよね
dialogue.English: I see... That gap might be adding to your distress right now... It's that painful for you, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい　何もかも…どうでもいいその反面、どうしようと…
dialogue.English: Yes... On the one hand, I feel like nothing matters... but on the other, I'm thinking, 'What am I going to do?'...

dialogue.content: ええ、自分の心の中で葛藤が起こっているのかもしれませんね。学校のこと、バイトのこと、金銭面,,,色々あるかもしれません何が一番しんどく感じられますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, it sounds like you might be having an internal conflict. There's school, your part-time job, your financial situation... there are many things. What feels the most difficult for you?

dialogue.content: この、生活辞めたいけど…もう、後戻りできなくて苦しいです。
dialogue.English: I want to quit this life, but... I can't go back now, and it's agonizing.

dialogue.content: そっか、そんな中ここに来てくれて私に話してくれて、それだけあなたは真剣に自分の人生に向き合っているんですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. The fact that you came here and talked to me amidst all of this shows just how seriously you are facing your own life.

dialogue.content: 後戻りできないっていうのは、どういうことかな...？後に引けない状況があるのかな？
dialogue.English: When you say you can't go back, what do you mean by that? Is there a situation you can't back out of?

dialogue.content: はい、でも…逃げたくなるんです。親に反対されたのに、押し切ってここに来たから…
dialogue.English: Yes, but... I feel like running away. My parents were against it, but I pushed through and came here...

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだったんですね...それくらいやりたいことだったんですよねだからこそ、希望とかやる気とかが大きかった分想像とは違う現実に、逃げたくなる気持ちも出てきてしまうんだと思うんです、とても自然な事ですよ
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened... That's how much you wanted to do this. I think it's because your hopes and motivation were so high that when reality turned out so differently from what you imagined, it makes you feel like running away. That's a very natural feeling.

dialogue.content: 本当に、苦しくて…
dialogue.English: It's just so painful...

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、話してくれてありがとう。一人で抱え込まず、私でよければ何でも聞くので少しでもお気持ちを吐き出してもらえればいいなと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I hear you. Thank you for sharing that. Please don't keep it all to yourself. If you're comfortable with it, I'm here to listen to anything, and I hope you can let out even a little bit of what you're feeling.

dialogue.content: 親御さんには難しいかもしれないですが、学校側にはなにかこういったことを相談できる人、もしくは窓口とかありますか？
dialogue.English: It might be difficult to talk to your parents, but is there anyone or a support office at your school you can talk to about these things?

dialogue.content: はい、学校にも相談してますか… 納得の行く回答は有りません。就職先も激減している状態奨学金についても、支払い義務が発生していると…
dialogue.English: Yes, I've consulted with the school, but... I haven't received any satisfactory answers. The number of job opportunities has plummeted, and as for the student loans, they just said I have an obligation to pay...

dialogue.content: なるほど、学校側の対応はそういったものなんですね...もっと誠実に対応してほしくなりますね..
dialogue.English: I see, so that was the school's response... It makes you wish they would handle it with more sincerity, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 私今調べてみたんです。○○○○機構の〇○○制度で奨学金の返済期間が伸ばせるというものがコロナで苦しむ学生さんたちのために設置されたみたいで
dialogue.English: I just did a quick search. It seems a system was set up by the XXXX organization, the OOO program, to help students struggling due to COVID by allowing them to extend their student loan repayment period.

dialogue.content: あなたも対象になる可能性が大いにあると思っています。もしお気持ちに無理が無ければ、ご紹介などのお手伝いを出来たら....なんて思ったのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I think there's a very high chance you could be eligible. If you're feeling up to it, I was thinking I could help you with things like a referral... How does that sound?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。手続きしたいと思いますが…返済期間が伸びても、就職先が厳しいと…この道に進んだのが間違いだった。
dialogue.English: I see. I'd like to apply, but... even if the repayment period is extended, if it's hard to find a job... Choosing this path was a mistake.

dialogue.content: もちろん、今はしんどくて何もする気になれないかもしれないのでこういった制度があることはお伝えさせてくださいね。選んだ道が後悔に変わってしまうほど希望に満ちていたという事ですよね....
dialogue.English: Of course, you might be feeling too overwhelmed to do anything right now, so for now, please just let me tell you that this kind of system exists. The fact that your chosen path has turned to regret must mean you were once that full of hope...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: コロナは誰のせいにもできないことでこの感情を吐き出す事、どこにぶつけたらいいのかさえわからないですよね
dialogue.English: COVID isn't anyone's fault, and it's hard to even know where to direct these feelings or how to let them out, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いま夜は眠れていますか？お食事などはどうですか？
dialogue.English: Are you able to sleep at night these days? How are you with your meals?

dialogue.content: 食事は寮なので食べてます。夜は、正直眠れないです
dialogue.English: I eat because I'm in a dorm. But honestly, I can't sleep at night.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね...眠れないときはどういったことを考えていますか？
dialogue.English: I see... When you can't sleep, what kinds of things are you thinking about?

dialogue.content: 今まで話して来た事が、頭を占領し、後悔ばかりです
dialogue.English: Everything we've been talking about fills my mind, and I'm just full of regret.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ...そういうお気持ちなんですよね苦しい思いをされながら踏ん張っていらっしゃるあなたが
dialogue.English: I understand... That's how you're feeling. Even while you’re in so much pain, you’re holding on.

dialogue.content: 今日ここで少し話したからと言って楽になれるなんて思わないけれどただ、あなたはひとりではないと今伝えたいです。
dialogue.English: I don't expect you to feel better just because we talked a little today, but I want to tell you right now that you are not alone.

dialogue.content: 吐き出しきれない気持ちを良ければまたお話しませんか？
dialogue.English: If you'd like, shall we talk again about the feelings you haven't been able to fully let out?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もちろん、無理はなさらず...気が向いた時で大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Of course, please don't push yourself... Whenever you feel up to it is fine.

dialogue.content: ロールプレイお疲れ様でした。貴重な時間をありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for the role-play session. I appreciate you taking this valuable time.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間になってしまいます。寒い日が続きますのでお体あたためてお過ごし下さい。
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is almost up. The cold days are continuing, so please stay warm and take care of yourself.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。またよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much. I look forward to working with you again.

dialogue.content: それでは、失礼致します。
dialogue.English: Well then, goodbye.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Goodbye.
